title: WSS: add extensibility clause to ChatStreamEnable.dataTypes
description: ChatStreamEnable.dataTypes (line 150-151) lists typing and presence. Line 161 says unrecognized values alongside recognized ones are silently ignored, but never says companion specs MAY register additional values. VTC needs to add vtc as a dataType for in-call ephemeral events. One sentence needed.
close_reason: Added extensibility clause to ChatStreamEnable.dataTypes noting companion specs MAY register additional values, with vtc example.
